tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Fetch a Silon API reference document as Markdown by its id.

``id`` is a value returned by ``search`` (``op:<operationId>``,
``tag:<Name>`` or ``doc:<anchor>``). For an operation the Markdown
includes the method and path, parameters, request/response schemas and
ready-to-run curl / Python / Node cod

tools.name: get_server_instructions
tools.description: Return MCP server instructions (if any). Always call first.

tools.name: list_sdks
tools.description:
List the official Silon client SDKs — one per language.

source repo, import statement and sync/async style. To read a language's
full guide call ``fetch`` with ``sdk:<lang>`` (e.g. ``sdk:python``); for

tools.name: sdk_snippet
tools.description:
Idiomatic SDK code for one API operation in one language.

``operation_id`` is an OpenAPI operationId (e.g. ``createMessage``,
``listContacts`` — the ``op:<operationId>`` ids returned by ``search``).
``lang`` is one of: python, node, java, dotnet, go, dart, php, ruby.
Returns the ready-to-run snippe

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search the Silon API reference for operations, tags and guide sections.

Returns ranked matches, each with a stable ``id`` (e.g. ``op:createMessage``,
``tag:Messages``, ``doc:authentication``). Pass an ``id`` to the ``fetch``
tool to read the full documentation for that entry.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
